summary: The document outlines the criteria for reporting serious injuries or illnesses to Cal/OSHA, defining them as incidents involving inpatient hospitalization, amputation, loss of an eye, or permanent disfigurement. It emphasizes the responsibility of EH&S to report such incidents immediately and provides a link to detailed procedures. Additionally, it mentions standardized forms for reporting workplace incidents, specifically the SU-17 Incident Investigation Report Form and the SU-17B Non-Employee Incident Report Form for non-employees. The document serves as a guideline for compliance with occupational safety regulations.
